evidence.title: Synthetic 2024 note — both paths share Kola Test Fibre
evidence.claim: In 2024 both Norrsken Path and MidnightSun Link were attested to depend on the same Kola Test Fibre hop.
evidence.limitations: Earlier synthetic attestation. Not deleted when later evidence appears. Scope is account-wide corridor claim.

evidence.title: Synthetic 2026 note — MidnightSun uses alternate hop
evidence.claim: In 2026 a later synthetic attestation states MidnightSun Link no longer uses Kola Test Fibre and lands via an alternate hop — conflicting with the 2024 shared-hop claim for the overlapping period boundary.
evidence.limitations: Later source has narrower account scope. Does not automatically invalidate the earlier record for 2024. Authority and coverage differ — contradiction remains unresolved.
